video.method: 36-second software showcase: genuine native terrain motion, six benefit-led still scenes and a matching motion finish. Silent, with brief background-colored fades.

galleryNote: Nine benefit-led compositions: hero, three locations, assembled/exploded, layered/flat, per-marker customization, automatic lake depth, genuine Studio import, full workbench, rectangular/circular artwork. All are software previews, not physical-build photos.

media.note: Before the current UI and automatic-depth fixes; retained intentionally.

legacyVideo.method: Native app Three.js layer meshes, matching the app explode formula; eased separation and reassembly with a looping camera orbit and automatic framing. Fresh motion captured at 60 fps and encoded with fast-start playback. No AI-generated frames or optical-flow interpolation.
legacyVideo.sequence: 0.4s assembled lead-in; 2.4s explosion to 90%; 1s exploded hold; 2.8s reassembly; 1.4s assembled finish. Camera motion continues throughout and returns to its starting pose.
